purpose: Continuously map repository Markdown plans, bot specifications, and requirements to existing implementation, tests, workflows, configuration, and unresolved references without treating documentation as proof of capability.
count_policy: all totals derived from current Git-tracked files and references

status_policy.broken_path_references: One or more referenced repository paths do not exist.
status_policy.implementation_reference_missing: Actionable documentation has no linked implementation path; manual code discovery is required.
status_policy.test_reference_missing: Implementation paths are referenced but no test path is referenced.
status_policy.implementation_and_test_paths_referenced: Code and test paths are linked, but their execution and outcomes must be checked separately.
status_policy.reference_only: Document contains no detected actionable implementation claims.

truth_rules: A Markdown statement is a requirement or proposal, not proof of implementation.
An existing code path is not proof that the code works.
A linked test path is not proof that the test passed.
Only run-specific CI, benchmark, regression, and production evidence can promote lifecycle status.
Do not delete or silently rewrite old documents; supersede them with dated decisions and traceable mappings.
